carryModeDescription.none: Each month starts from the plan amount.
carryModeDescription.surplus: Unspent budget rolls into the next month; overspend is forgiven.
carryModeDescription.deficit: Overspend is deducted from the next month; unspent budget is dropped.
carryModeDescription.both: The net balance, positive or negative, rolls into the next month.

planEditor.carryHelp: Carry-over rolls each month's leftover (surplus, deficit, or both) into the next month from this plan's effective month on. "Reset from this month" drops whatever balance a category brings into this month.
